def allocate_fixed(total,weights):
 if type(total)is not int or not 0<=total<=10000000 or not weights or any(type(x)is not int or not 0<=x<=10000000 for x in weights):return None
 s=sum(weights)
 if s==0 or s>10000000:return None
 o=[total*x//s for x in weights];left=total-sum(o);order=sorted(range(len(weights)),key=lambda i:(-(total*weights[i]%s),i))
 for i in order[:left]:o[i]+=1
 return o
